docs.summary: Helpers for generating names that don't collide with an existing set. All entry points share one core: a separator pair plus a "does this name already exist?" predicate, so callers can plug in whatever scope they need (string set, GO siblings, filesystem, an InputActionMap, ...) without writing the loop themselves.

members.name: MakeUnique
members.signature: public static string MakeUnique(string desired, Func<string, bool> exists, string openSeparator = " (", string closeSeparator = ")", bool stripExistingSuffix = true, int startNumber = 1, bool allowBaseName = true)

docs.summary: Find a name that doesn't satisfy `exists`, by appending `{openSeparator}{N}{closeSeparator}` for the smallest free N.

params.desired: The name we'd like to use.
params.exists: Returns true if the candidate name is already taken.
params.openSeparator: String inserted between the base name and the number - e.g. `" ("` for `"Cube (1)"`, `"_"` for `"name_1"`, or `""` for `"Action1"`.
params.closeSeparator: String appended after the number - e.g. `")"` for the parens style, empty for the others.
params.stripExistingSuffix: When true, an existing trailing suffix matching this format is parsed off and its number used as the starting point. `"Cube (3)"` tries `"Cube (4)"` first instead of `"Cube (3) (1)"`.
params.startNumber: First number to try when no suffix is found / parsed. Defaults to 1.
params.allowBaseName: When a suffix was stripped, whether the bare base name may be returned if it is free. False always counts on, so `"Cube (3)"` never comes back as `"Cube"`.

members.name: ForGameObjectSibling
members.signature: public static string ForGameObjectSibling(string desired, GameObject? parent, Scene scene)

docs.summary: Make a name unique against `parent`'s children - or, when parent is null, against `scene`'s root objects. Uses the `" (N)"` convention with strip-and-increment, so duplicating `"Cube (3)"` yields `"Cube (4)"`.

members.name: ForFile
members.signature: public static string ForFile(string folder, string baseName, string ext)

docs.summary: Find a free filename inside `folder`. Considers both files and directories as collisions. Result is `baseName + ext` (or `baseName (N) + ext`); the extension must include the leading dot (or be empty for folders). Uses the `" (N)"` convention.

members.name: ForCopy
members.signature: public static string ForCopy(string folder, string baseName, string ext)

docs.summary: Like [`ForFile`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Utils.UniqueNames~ForFile), but count on from an existing `" (N)"` suffix, so copying `"Mat (1)"` beside itself yields `"Mat (2)"`.
